description:
Presolicitation notice to industry. Solicitation for Rations National Contract (RNC) Bakery Components will soon be published. Bakery components are included in the assembly of the Meal, Ready-to-Eat (MRE). This acquisition is for the bakery components utilized in the MRE program. 

Applicable NAICS codes for this acquisition are as follows:

311821 - Cookie and Cracker Manufacturing 

311812 - Commercial Bakeries 

311830 - Tortilla Manufacturing
